_about: One row per movement rule. mordhau_property: property on MORDHAU's character movement component (CharMoveComp inside Mordhau/Content/Mordhau/Blueprints/Characters/BP_MordhauCharacter) or, where source says character, on the character definition itself; read at runtime from the player's own MORDHAU. null = MORDHAU's data has no such number; the fallback is then this mod's own choice. fallback: used when MORDHAU has no value or is not installed. Units are MORDHAU's (centimetres, seconds); 1 Skyrim unit = 1.42875 cm. hook: row id in hooks.json.

rows.rule: speed over the ground with no sprint, any direction but backward
sprint speed as a multiple of base speed; forward only
time holding sprint to reach full sprint speed
sprint only while moving within this angle of straight ahead
backward speed as a multiple of base speed
moving more than this angle away from straight ahead counts as backward
how fast speed builds from a standstill
upward speed at take-off; with gravity_scale it sets the jump height
gravity as a multiple of 980 cm/s2
max turn rate while a swing is in release (per attack: TurnCaps, not decoded yet)
